prompt: Researchers ___ an experiment to test the hypothesis. (make / do / take / have)
I need to ___ a decision about which university to attend.
explanation: Make a decision (UK también take a decision).

prompt: Governments must ___ action to reduce emissions.
Students should ___ their homework before playing video games.
The new policy will ___ a significant difference to people's lives.
Tourism can ___ harm to fragile ecosystems.
explanation: Do harm / do damage / cause harm.

prompt: It is important to ___ into account the needs of elderly people.
explanation: Take into account = tener en cuenta.

prompt: Many people ___ a mistake when they choose a career for money alone.
explanation: Make a mistake (no do a mistake).

prompt: Could you ___ me a favour and proofread my essay?
The team has ___ considerable progress on the project.
Teenagers often ___ risks without thinking about the consequences.
explanation: Take a risk / run a risk.

prompt: Technology ___ a key role in modern education.
The two studies ___ different conclusions.
explanation: Reach / draw / come to a conclusion.

prompt: Public campaigns aim to ___ awareness of mental health issues.
explanation: Raise awareness (no rise awareness: rise es intransitivo).

prompt: Parents should ___ a good example for their children.
The government has ___ measures to tackle obesity.
Exercise can ___ the risk of heart disease.
explanation: Reduce / lower / cut the risk son las colocaciones más naturales.

prompt: Many companies ___ research into artificial intelligence.
explanation: Do / carry out / conduct research (no make research).

prompt: Working long hours can ___ a negative effect on health.
Please ___ attention to the instructions before you begin.
explanation: Pay attention (no put attention, calco de «poner atención»).

prompt: The findings ___ the hypothesis that sleep improves memory. (apoyan)
Scientists have ___ a strong link between smoking and cancer.
The issue has been the subject of ___ debate for decades. (mucho, intenso)
Cities need to ___ the problem of traffic congestion.
explanation: Tackle / address a problem: más académico que solve en ensayos.

prompt: Unemployment remains a ___ concern in many regions. (importante)
The project aims to ___ the needs of local communities.
explanation: Meet the needs / meet a demand / meet a deadline.

prompt: The survey ___ data from 2,000 participants.
The new law ___ into effect in January.
explanation: Come / go into effect = entrar en vigor.

prompt: Some economists ___ doubt on the reliability of these figures.
explanation: Cast doubt on (cast es irregular: cast-cast-cast).

prompt: Investment in renewables could ___ thousands of new jobs.
The graph shows a ___ increase in obesity rates. (fuerte, marcado)
Prices remained ___ throughout the decade. (sin cambios)
Sales reached a ___ of 3 million in 2018. (punto máximo)
Online learning has become an ___ part of higher education. (esencial)
There is a ___ consensus among scientists that climate change is real. (amplio)
The ___ (develop) of new vaccines has saved millions of lives.
There is a strong ___ (relate) between income and health.
Rapid ___ (urban) has led to overcrowded cities.
The ___ (significant) of this discovery cannot be overstated.
Many young people are ___ (employ) despite having degrees. (sin trabajo)
It is ___ (possible) to predict the weather with complete accuracy.
The policy was highly ___ (effect) in reducing crime.
The results were ___ (consist) with previous studies.

explanation: Delante de un adjetivo (friendly) va adverbio: environmentally.

prompt: The ___ (rely) of online information is often questionable.
Obesity has become ___ (increase) common among children.
The two groups were ___ (compare) in size.
Children need ___ (encourage) from their teachers.
The ___ (analyse) of the data took three months.
Some traditional jobs have become ___ (necessary) due to automation.
explanation: Prefijo un- con doble n: unnecessary.

prompt: The museum attracts a wide ___ (vary) of visitors.
Many people feel ___ (anxiety) before an exam.
Smoking is ___ (legal) in many public places. (prohibido por ley)
The government's ___ to raise taxes was unpopular.
explanation: Tras el genitivo se necesita un sustantivo: decision.

prompt: Prices fell ___ in the first half of the year.
explanation: Para modificar un verbo (fell) se usa adverbio.
